subject: SIG-Lite walkthrough & evidence mapping for ClearHorizon
messages:
From: Maya Desai <maya@clearhorizon.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ethan Rowe <ethan.rowe@clearhorizon.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: SIG-Lite questionnaire — walkthrough request & network diagram

Hi Lukas,

Thanks for taking this on. We're starting our SIG-Lite intake for Redwood and would like to schedule a 45-minute walkthrough with your security team to go through the questionnaire, ask a few clarifying questions, and confirm evidence owners.

Quick context: we're the security intake team at ClearHorizon. We typically run through the SIG-Lite spreadsheet, validate control owner names, and ask for a short architecture diagram for cloud/networking and data flow for production systems.

Proposed times: Mon 26 Oct 09:30–10:15 UTC or Tue 27 Oct 14:00–14:45 UTC. Our attendees will be myself (security intake), Ethan (platform), and optionally our compliance lead if needed.

I've attached the latest SIG-Lite file from our side (ClearHorizon_SIG_Lite_v3.xlsx) and a short intake checklist. Please confirm which time works and whether you can share: 1) an internal SOC 2 summary / SOC 2 scope doc, 2) a high-level network/architecture diagram, and 3) a list of technical owners for the controls we flag.

Thanks,
Maya Desai
Security Intake Lead
ClearHorizon

Attachments: ClearHorizon_SIG_Lite_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), intake-checklist.pdf (2 pages)

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Desai <maya@clearhorizon.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 12:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SIG-Lite questionnaire — walkthrough request & network diagram

Hi Maya — appreciate the file and the suggested windows. Tue 27 Oct 14:00–14:45 UTC works best for our team; I've tentatively reserved that slot.

Pre-call we can provide:
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (high-level scope and in-scope services)
- a short network-architecture-diagram.png (high level, no VPC peering secrets)
- a mapping of control owners for SIG-Lite questions (we'll mark primary owners in the sheet)

Action: Irene, can you assemble the SOC2 summary + network diagram and populate the first pass of owner mapping? Marissa, can you join the call to own the demo & product clarifications if they ask?

Maya — could you confirm the meeting invite recipient list (we'll add Zoom) and indicate any specific controls you especially want to deep-dive on (auth, data retention, logging)? Also please share any sections of the spreadsheet you expect us to pre-populate to speed the call.

Thanks,
Lukas Meyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference platform

On Thu, 22 Oct 2026 at 09:12, Maya Desai <maya@clearhorizon.com> wrote:
> Hi Lukas,
> 
> Thanks for taking this on. We're starting our SIG-Lite intake for Redwood...

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Desai <maya@clearhorizon.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 12:09:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SIG-Lite questionnaire — walkthrough request & network diagram

Irene / Marissa — looping you both in to prep for ClearHorizon. Short action list: 

Irene:
- Finalize redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (1–2 pages) covering scope, trust services in scope, auditor & last report date. Aim to include where logging/retention are handled (console + ingest pipeline).
- Produce a redacted network-architecture-diagram.png (cloud regions, major VPCs, gateway boundaries). No sensitive IPs.
- Start a first-pass owner mapping for the SIG-Lite spreadsheet. I will upload our answers to their sheet before the call.

Marissa:
- Be ready to demo how audit/logging events surface in the Console and to answer questions about retention/export.
- Please confirm availability for Tue 27 Oct 14:00–14:45 UTC and I'll include you on the calendar invite.

I'll draft a brief pre-populated sheet and share a Drive link shortly. We should aim to have the artifacts in the shared folder by EOD Mon 26 Oct so we can triage any gaps.

Thanks — Lukas

> On Thu, 22 Oct 2026 at 12:05, Lukas Meyer <lukas@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> > Hi Maya — appreciate the file and the suggested windows. Tue 27 Oct...

From: Maya Desai <maya@clearhorizon.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ethan Rowe <ethan.rowe@clearhorizon.com>, security@clearhorizon.com
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 08:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SIG-Lite questionnaire — walkthrough request & network diagram

Thanks, Lukas — Tue 27 Oct 14:00–14:45 UTC confirmed. I've included Ethan and our compliance lead on the invite. Zoom link in calendar.

Attendees from ClearHorizon: Maya Desai (security intake), Ethan Rowe (platform), Claire Hsu (compliance).

We're especially interested in diving into: authentication (SSO & provisioning), data retention for embeddings & logs, and your RBAC/multi-tenant isolation boundary. If you can pre-fill the SIG-Lite for those sections, that would be super helpful.

I've uploaded our working SIG-Lite to the Drive link below and added a short note in cells where we think clarification is needed: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDefGH_clearhorizon-sig

See you on Tue.

Best,
Maya Desai
Security Intake Lead
ClearHorizon

Attachments: ClearHorizon_SIG_Lite_v3.xlsx (updated)
